question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party and its institutions as of mid-2026, with recent developments underscoring the low probability of his removal before 2027. At age 73 and after nearly 15 years in power, he has overseen ongoing military and political purges to enforce loyalty, convened key cadre meetings such as the August Beidaihe gathering to advance party discipline, and positioned allies for a likely fourth term at the 21st Party Congress late next year. These steps build on the 2018 removal of presidential term limits and the absence of designated successors, reflecting trader consensus on institutional entrenchment. While a sudden health event or major elite fracture could theoretically alter the outcome, verifiable indicators point to continuity through the resolution window.
